participation.context: Wrote the head and the two lines, and stopped the sheet there.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the address and the answer on a clean sheet. You left the quarrel for later in the day.

title: Wrote the King's address and the old man's four words

participation.context: Spoke the line until the mouth was the one he will play.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the answer three ways and stopped. You gave the long address to the King and kept the four words.

participation.context: Wrote the quarrel by dinner, and stopped at sixty with no blots.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the two gages and the King between them. You marked sixty lines and no blots. The morning's two lines stayed on the first sheet.

title: Wrote the quarrel and counted sixty lines

story.body: You put the one sentence on the tables. You left the sixty lines as they were.

title: Wrote on the tables that he likes to hear himself
